pages.text: Tinker's Forging adds various tool parts which can be enabled by material JSON and then crafted into tools. These include the Hammer Head, Pickaxe Head, Shovel Head, Axe Head, Sword Blade, and Hoe Head. Anvil recipes for these parts are pack-defined with CraftTweaker.
The hammer head can be used to craft the Tinker's Hammer. A pack can add its forging recipe with CraftTweaker, for example five ingots into one hammer head.
The pickaxe head can be used to craft a pickaxe. A pack can add its forging recipe with CraftTweaker, for example three ingots into one pickaxe head.
The shovel head can be used to craft a shovel. A pack can add its forging recipe with CraftTweaker, for example one ingot into one shovel head.
The axe head can be used to craft an axe. A pack can add its forging recipe with CraftTweaker, for example three ingots into one axe head.
The sword blade can be used to craft a sword. A pack can add its forging recipe with CraftTweaker, for example two ingots into one sword blade.
The hoe head can be used to craft a hoe. A pack can add its forging recipe with CraftTweaker, for example two ingots into one hoe head.
